context_map.exchanged_information: Raw device transmissions carrying Telemetry Samples; initiated by devices; immediate, backpressure-governed.
context_map.boundary_protection: Intake exposes one stable device-facing contract for many device types; device-specific formats never leak past Intake; Ingress Packet is the only internal form.

context_map.exchanged_information: IngressPacketReceived: Ingress Packet with samples and t_ingress; stream-driven, immediate with backpressure.
context_map.boundary_protection: Only the event crosses; backpressure/transport internals stay in Intake; Validation negotiates required packet fields.

context_map.exchanged_information: TelemetrySampleValidated / TelemetrySampleValidationFailed: sample with t_device and validation status; eventual, streaming.
context_map.boundary_protection: Sensor Metric Boundary rules never leak; Reordering only reads the status flag and orders by t_device, never t_ingress; failed samples are passed, not dropped.

context_map.exchanged_information: TelemetryWindowReordered / TelemetryBackfillApplied: chronologically ordered samples and backfill frames; eventual.
context_map.boundary_protection: Window buffers and reorder internals stay private; Log treats backfills as appended Event Revisions, never mutations.

context_map.direction: Telemetry Event Log -> external (downstream analytics event streams)
context_map.boundary_protection: Versioned, append-only event contract for many consumers; storage internals never exposed; consumers cannot write back.

cross_boundary_flows.business_process: Ingest and persist a 1Hz telemetry sample
cross_boundary_flows.notes: Reactive stream with backpressure end to end; consumers must be idempotent. FLAG: delivery posture/dedup identity (retry vs Event Revision) undecided between Intake and Event Log; return to discovery.

Within 60s window reordered by t_device, appended as revisions. FLAG: samples later than 60s unspecified. FLAG: ranges missing for ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke; swim pace has no upper bound. Context chain is acyclic; no coupling cycles.

cross_boundary_flows.business_process: Broadcast appended telemetry to downstream analytics
cross_boundary_flows.notes: Broadcast placement in Event Log is a low-confidence assumption; may become its own context.
